title: Assign Universaarl number series to setup pages
purpose: Assign already proven U-* Number Series Lines to the relevant Business Central setup fields before creating master data or documents.
entryCriteria: U-CUST line has visible Startnr./Endnr. after reopen.
U-VEND, U-ITEM, U-SO, U-SINV, U-PO and U-PINV lines have visible Startnr./Endnr. after reopen.
No setup-page assignment has been proven yet.
exitCriteria: Each assigned setup field has before, after and reopen proof.
No master data, document, preview posting or posting was executed.
If a target field is hidden or ambiguous, stop and document Page/FastTab/field diagnostics instead of guessing.
stopIf: BC shows any instance other than playthru.
BC shows any active company other than UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A setup field cannot be unambiguously mapped to the intended number-series purpose.
A confirmation dialog asks to create master data, post, preview, delete or change unrelated setup.
A lookup/search result could assign the wrong U-* code.
A page requires hidden FastTabs, personalization or Page Inspection before the target field can be safely identified.
